_doc: Short sequences of the player's body for judging movement in the motion studio (game/tools_gd/motion_studio.gd): a start and a stop from a jog, a turn on the spot, the roll from a tap of Shift and from Ctrl, a light swing, and the camera's follow through the player's own view. Real key events through the input map. xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x720x24' godot --path game --rendering-driver vulkan --rendering-method forward_plus --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 --fixed-fps 60 res://tools_gd/motion_studio.tscn -- --plan=tools/capture/plans/motion.json --out=captures/motion
